name: How long does basement drywall installation take from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: How long does basement drywall installation take from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: For an average basement between 600 and 1,000 square feet, the entire drywall phase typically takes 7 to 10 working days. The process breaks down into distinct steps: hanging the drywall panels takes 1 to 2 days, followed by 3 to 4 sequential coats of joint compound, with dedicated drying time between each pass. Final sanding and detail touch-ups add another 1 to 2 days. Cold or humid basement air can extend mud drying times, requiring portable fans or heat.
acceptedAnswer.description: An average basement drywall project takes 7 to 10 working days, covering hanging, multiple coats of taping and mudding, drying time, and final sanding.
